name: browser_run_actions
description: Execute a batch sequence of browser actions in a single tool call to minimize LLM token usage and latency. Supports open_tab, navigate, wait_for_selector, scroll_into_view, click, type, press_key, scroll, sleep, screenshot, get_element, evaluate, cdp, and close_tab. Automatically scrolls off-screen elements into view before clicking or typing.

tabId.description: Optional initial target Tab ID. Defaults to the tab opened in the batch or the current agent tab.

stopOnError.description: Whether to halt the batch sequence immediately if any step fails (default: true).

actions.description: Ordered array of actions to execute sequentially.

url.description: Target URL for open or navigate

active.description: Whether to make opened tab active (default false to avoid stealing user focus)

waitUntil.description: Wait for page load complete on open/navigate (default true)

selector.description: CSS selector for click, type, scroll_into_view, wait_for_selector, or get_element

text.description: Text to type into input field

clear.description: Clear existing text before typing (default false)

pressEnter.description: Press Enter key after typing (default false)

key.description: Key name to press for press_key (e.g. Enter, Escape, Tab)

x.description: Target X pixel coordinate for click

y.description: Target Y pixel coordinate for click

deltaY.description: Vertical scroll amount (positive down, negative up)

expression.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate via CDP

label.description: Optional label for screenshot or step result
